svg.title: Up to n = 100 the five growth curves separate sharply: n squared reaches 10,000 operations where n log n reaches 664 and n reaches 100.
svg.desc: Operation count against input size n from 1 to 100, on linear axes. Five series, each with its own dash pattern and a label drawn at the end of its curve: constant stays flat at 1; logarithmic reaches about 6.6; linear is a straight line to 100; linearithmic curves gently to 664; quadratic climbs steeply to 10,000 and is clipped by the top of the panel at n = 100. Exponential is omitted from this panel because 2 to the power 100 is about 1.3 times 10 to the 30, which no shared axis can show; it appears in the log-log runtime figure instead.
svg.text: Operations against input size, linear axes

g.text: O(2ⁿ) is not drawn here: at n = 100 it is about 1.3 × 10³⁰, which no shared axis can show.
